newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's banking sector drives bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's banking sector drives bourse higher.

text.p: Casablanca stock market ended the week on Friday higher pushed mainly by banking stocks including Banque Commerciale du maroc, traders said.
The all-share index rose to 432.95, from 427.60 points a week earlier.

"The market returned to its upward trend after a week of stagnation...The banking sector remains the engine behind the bourse index rise this week," a Casablanca-based stockbroker said. BCM, Morocco's second largest bank, gained 31 dirhams in a week to close at 691 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a market blue chip, closed at 407 dirhams, up two dirhams from 405 last Friday.
Credit Eqdom jumped to 1,110 dirhams from 980 dirhams last week.
Eqdom plans to increase its capital to 166.6 million ($19.1 million) from 111.1 million dirhams. It said the capital would be increased in two simultanous operations of stock split and rights issue.

Societe Nationale d'Investissement, which holds a diversified stakes in more than 40 companies, closed at 580 dirhams, unchanged compared with last week. SNI has a market capitalisation of more than 5.7 billion dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was on Friday 36.9 million dirhams, up from 24.4 million dirhams a week earlier.
